followUpFindings.title: Night boundary with delayed FALSE readback skipped physical OFF
followUpFindings.reproduced: One ON command remained with target=0 and autoStopPending=false
followUpFindings.fix: Forced OFF command and post-command measurement time required

followUpFindings.title: Failed persistence was cached and lost pending OFF across restart
followUpFindings.reproduced: One failed pending persistence followed by failed actuator writes and morning restart caused external_manual_knx_observed
followUpFindings.fix: Cache only after successful persistence; physical OFF continues despite diagnostic persistence failure

followUpFindings.title: Confirmed stage retained persistent 250 W battery supply
followUpFindings.reproduced: Confirmed 1500 W stage held for four simulated minutes with 250 W battery discharge and valid forecast
followUpFindings.fix: Confirmed stages use at most 50 W tolerance and at most 3 s observation, followed by a physical downward step

followUpFindings.title: Failed OFF and pre-command FALSE measurement with identical millisecond timestamp prematurely confirms OFF
followUpFindings.reproduced: All three setForeignStateAsync calls reject, but pending=false and status=night_pv_auto_blocked_confirmed_write-failed-retry when readback timestamp equals command timestamp
followUpFindings.fix: Rejected OFF cannot confirm in that attempt; measurements require a strictly later timestamp; restored pending without local command-time evidence requires a new physical OFF attempt.

reviewer: Separate collaborating review agent; not external certification
limits: No live ioBroker installation or relay, KNX, inverter or battery hardware test performed.
No proof of real-time maximum response on target device; configured intervals and I/O latency determine observed physical delay.
Actual valid and fresh PV, grid, battery and heater power mappings must be verified during device commissioning.
Full release, integrity, SBOM, package and broader regression gates are coordinated separately by the parent agent.
New zero-export probes require original PV/grid/battery and heater power measurements no older than 5 seconds; actual update cadence must be verified on the installation.
